relations.myth: Galvarino urges Caupolicán’s council to reject peace
relations.note: Galvarino displays his wounds and persuades Caupolicán’s council to renew resistance.

relations.myth: Orompello condemns Galbarino for killing Guillén
relations.note: Orompello confronts Galbarino, condemns the alleged killing, and predicts his mutilation.
Alcaguendo travels or acts alongside Galbarino during the campaign.
Tucapel answers Galbarino’s speech by recommitting himself to war.
Fresia and Galbarino independently shame those considering submission.
Engol and Galbarino appear in the council opposing submission.
